propositions: Deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus, pre-registered thresholds, mutation-assembly script, benchmark driver store-isolation seams, and pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 with golden/synthetic tests passing offline.

The expensive ~100-run LLM batch baseline (live gate sweep and e2_baseline.json / e2_run_validity.json / e2_verdicts.jsonl outputs) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder accumulating detection/FP signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed due to impact_model_version bump stranding legacy data.

The mutant corpus contains ≥10 mutants per defect class 1–4 (class 5 degrades to N≥5) paired with controls, each carrying pair_id, defect_class, role, source_ticket_id, plan_text, children, mutation_op, and mutation_diff; class-5 controls retain stripped [operator-attested] AC lines.

Store isolation is implemented by construction: the benchmark harness sources mutants from a standalone git clone --local --branch tickets with independent .git directory, preventing contamination of the real .tickets-tracker.

The deterministic half is intentionally not landed on main because the harness only exists to drive the rejected LLM batch, and operator-approved rescope (2026-07-18) accepts the WIP as the deliverable.
